notes: First-party site is Clover COLO2 with no redirect and no client content (JS-rendered); Grubhub client-renders and carries no JSON-LD prices in its page HTML. Filed from Uber Eats' embedded schema.org Restaurant/Menu JSON-LD (doubly percent/unicode-escaped inside __REACT_QUERY_STATE__; decoded via two unescape passes). Address confirmed 110 West Washington Street, San Diego CA 92103 matches batch record exactly. Deduped raw 318 rows (JSON-LD embedded twice) to 317 on name+section+price, dropped one $0.00 'Rice' side with no real price -> 316 filed. Subtraction test: 5 separate Especial-vs-regular soup pairs (Albondigas, Pozole, Tlalpeno, Vegetable Soup, Caldo de Res family) each differ by exactly $2.38, confirming genuine per-item pricing rather than a computed/corrupted field. Divisor sweep 1.00-1.35 found no better fit than raw (16.4% conventional at mult=1), so no fee markup detected. Cross-checked against Grubhub search-snippet prices (Ceviche Especial $13.99, Especial Albondigas $12.99, Especial Fish Taco $2.99, Special 3 Roll Tacos Rice & Beans $11.99) which match the Uber Eats capture exactly, different platform owner.

name: Crumbl Cookies
blocked: Crumbl's own site (crumblcookies.com/stores/ca/cacarlsbad) lists weekly rotating cookie FLAVOR names with calories but no per-flavor prices (cookies are priced only by pack size, not flavor). DoorDash's authoritative menuBook for this exact store (961 Palomar Airport Rd) lists only 2 categories, 'Most Ordered' (a duplicate carousel) and 'Large Desserts', which dedupe to exactly 4 distinct items: Single $6.39, 4-Pack $22.79, 6-Pack $31.09, 12-Pack $49.49. Uber Eats for the same store corroborates the same 4-item structure at slightly different prices ($6.29/$22.49/$30.59/$48.69). A Grubhub search snippet for this address mentioned additional Mini 3/6/12-Pack items, but Grubhub's page is client-rendered with no extractable prices and neither DoorDash's nor Uber Eats' current catalog for this store carries a Mini category, so those could not be confirmed. Only 4 distinct priced items are corroborated, below the 5-item menu minimum, so blocking rather than filing.

name: Zappy Pizza
notes: zappyspizza.com's own site is gated behind a sgcaptcha redirect and unfetchable via curl, but its own 'order online' link resolves to order.online (a white-label direct-ordering platform), which returns clean server-rendered HTML with 25 name+price pairs across pizzas, wings, sides, and 2L sodas (11 distinct prices, matching the earlier unique-price count). Cross-checked against Uber Eats ($12.99 Hawaiian) and Postmates ($18.99 Cheese Pizza Combo) search snippets for the same store/address: those prices are consistently ~18-19% higher than order.online's ($10.99 Hawaiian, $15.99 Cheese Pizza Combo) -- ratio 12.99/10.99=1.182, 18.99/15.99=1.188 -- a matched delivery-platform markup multiplier, not a genuine price disagreement, so order.online (the direct/pickup-priced source) was used as filed.
